THE ENGINEERING CONTROL

Windows may move.
Recordings never split.

Stratified Group K-Fold4 FOLDS

GROUP = FILE_ID

Every recording stays wholly in train or test. Each outer test fold contains every class, including Normal.

Train on three loads. Test on the fourth. This exposes load-sensitive shortcuts that random window splitting would hide.
